improvements: Round-1 finding 1 is fixed. Raw calls 2 -> 0, raw reverts 4 -> 0, P6 gone. Text 259 lines shorter.

summary: No regression. The unresolved-free-pointer finding is fixed (reverts, events, mint/collect calls decoded), and the dead memory writes and the only copy loop are gone. PairLimit slices, mulDiv constants and the subtraction-check form remain.
